title: SAP Application Specialist
description:
Position: SAP Application Specialist
Location: Remote
Duration: 3 months + possible extensions
Work Schedule: 30 hours per week | Standard business hours | Remote


Overview:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Generalist with strong technical expertise in development and configuration across multiple SAP modules. This role will play a key part in supporting a mining industry client by ensuring seamless integration, optimal performance, and alignment of SAP solutions with business objectives. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across modules, managing system configurations, and providing both technical support and user training.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Oversee the integration and management of SAP MM (Materials Management), PM (Project Management), Security, and Finance modules.
  • Manage and optimize system configurations to enhance performance and address evolving business needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement SAP solutions that align with organizational goals.
  • Analyze system requirements, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide efficient technical solutions.
  • Support end-users by delivering training, documentation, and ongoing technical assistance.
  • Conduct system audits to ensure data integrity, security compliance, and optimal system performance.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Extensive hands-on experience with SAP MM, PM, Security, and Finance modules.
  • Strong technical expertise in SAP development and configuration, including ABAP programming and system customization.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage complex projects.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a focus on supporting and training users.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

title: UX UI Designer
description:
NO C2C- W2/1099

USC/GC

Position Title UX UI Designer
Hybrid- Chicago IL
Must have Skills/Attributes FIGMA, UX DESIGN

Position Description
Required Education:
• Bachelor's degree in UX, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, HCI, or a related field.

Mandatory Qualifications ( "Must-Haves ")
• 7+ years of professional UX/UI experience in an enterprise or agency setting.
• Proven experience creating desktop, responsive web, and mobile applications.
• Expert proficiency in Figma and Figjam (specifically building and maintaining asset libraries).
• A strong portfolio demonstrating user interface design and design systems work.
• Experience working within and contributing to established design systems.

Preferred Qualifications ( "Nice-to-Haves ")
• Experience with design tokens in Figma.
• Familiarity with AG Grid and ZeroHeight.
• Experience managing a design backlog and sizing work.
• Financial services industry experience (a plus, but not required).
• Skills in storyboarding, data visualization, animation, or usability studies.

The designer will be the third member of the Design System design team. The primary focus is on detailed visual and interface design, component creation, and design token work for an enterprise-scale design system. This is a senior-level, individual contributor role that requires strong collaboration with both design and development teams to maintain and evolve the design system used across the company's products.

Key Responsibilities
• Maintain, evolve, and create assets and pattern libraries in Figma.
• Design accessible, inclusive components and write supporting documentation.
• Implement designs based on the existing system and UX best practices.
• Collaborate closely with developers to ensure high-quality implementation.
• Help establish consistent delivery processes and handoff patterns for the design system.

Soft Kills:
• Must be a self-driven, collaborative problem-solver with strong communication skills.

Application & Interview Process
• Portfolio is required.
• Interview Process: Two rounds.
• Candidates should be prepared to answer questions from an attached questionnaire (provided to suppliers as a guide).

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Enterprise Architect to join a leading Randstad client in Washington, D.C. In this role, you will be a key technical leader, responsible for translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical designs. You will provide critical oversight and guidance across multiple projects, ensuring all solutions align with established architectural principles. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in large-scale enterprise environments and a deep understanding of IT, OT, and business architecture, with a particular focus on the transportation or railroad logistics domain. Your expertise will be vital in driving technical vision and moving the organization forward with innovative and robust solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with Solution Architects and engineering teams to translate business requirements into comprehensive and robust technical designs.

  • Assist in the architectural design and implementation of software components, features, and modules, ensuring adherence to architectural principles and standards.

  • Provide technical oversight and guidance to support teams, troubleshooting complex issues and ensuring the stability and performance of systems.

  • Ensure that all products are scalable, secure, and maintainable within their designated domain.

  • Contribute to the strategic vision of the organization by providing architectural guidance and selecting appropriate platforms for future initiatives.

  • Lead and manage multiple architecture engagements, effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve key architectural objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data and Intelligence, or a related field, with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Demonstrated, repeated experience successfully directing complex, large-scale architecture initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, lines of business, and highly regulated environments.

  • Proven experience as an architect within enterprises of $500MM or more, providing vision and making key platform decisions to drive business transformation.

  • Deep knowledge of IT, OT, domain, and business architecture.

  • Strong understanding of railroad or broader transportation logistics, including operational workflows for dispatch, scheduling, and asset management.

  • Expertise in networking, cloud computing (e.g., Azure, AWS), and on-premise infrastructure.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work effectively within integrated, cross-functional teams.
